Subject: FinOptics — post-call recap & proposed POC plan

Thanks again for taking the call today, Olivia — appreciated the context on your data cadence and what success looks like. Quick recap and a proposed next-steps plan so we're all aligned. Attached: finoptics-poc-plan.xlsx (POC timeline + success criteria).

Recap (high level)
- Goal: Validate that Redwood can serve FinOptics' real-time scoring pipeline with median latency < 120ms and 99th percentile < 350ms for 1k concurrent users while maintaining quality on your classification task.
- Primary dataset: anonymized user event stream + labels (you mentioned ~50k labelled events).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  1) Latency: median < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for 256-token requests
  2) Cost: < $0.015 per 1k tokens served in steady-state projection (post-batching)
  3) Quality: baseline metric lift >= 6% over current model on your eval set (F1)
  4) Ops: ability to rotate keys and audit logs for all PII-safe requests

Proposed POC plan & owners (see attached workbook for detailed schedule):
- Week 0 (this week): exchange sample dataset + access checklist — Owner: Olivia/Ben (FinOptics)
- Week 1: ingest & sandbox setup (private VPC test), endpoint config, baseline run — Owner: Dev Patel (Eng)
- Week 2: integration tests, perf tuning (batching & quantization), early eval — Owner: Dev + Marcus
- Week 3: final eval, runbook, rollout recommendation — Owner: Marissa (CS)

Open items / asks for this week:
1) Can you confirm delivery of a zipped sample (<= 50k rows) and an export of your label mapping by end of day Friday?
2) Please confirm any network egress/IP allowlist constraints so we can provision the VPC endpoints.
3) Any compliance checklist items we should pre-share with your security team (SOC2 docs, data retention statements)?

Next steps: I've attached the POC workbook (finoptics-poc-plan.xlsx) — if that looks good I'll loop in Dev to propose test env dates. Happy to jump on a quick 30-min sync if you prefer to walk through the plan.

Best,
Marcus Lin
